caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with a reddish-brown finish and decorative top edges. The upper section contains a circular clock face with black Roman numerals and two black clock hands. The clock face background is pale, featuring red and pink floral decorations near the center and in each corner of the square border surrounding the clock face. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular glass panel displaying a colored illustration of a man in a blue military uniform with gold epaulets standing next to a white horse. The man is holding a hat in his left hand and resting his right arm on the horse’s back. There is green grass, a brown cannon wheel, and a cannonball on the ground beside the man, with a landscape of mountains and a faint sky in the background. The word "WASHINGTON" appears in capital letters below this illustration. The sides of the clock feature painted columns with black backgrounds and golden floral designs. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background, and there is a small handwritten note at the bottom right corner.
title: Clock
